plugins.name: hone
plugins.description: Test-driven, largely unattended development for Claude Code. You write a short plan for one change, and an automated loop builds it test-first in an isolated git worktree, runs every check, reviews the result, and merges it. Two characteristics define it. The honing: docs stay minimal, hone deletes anything the code, types, or tests already show, and a garden pass between changes keeps cutting what goes stale. The enforcement: hooks allow no production code without a failing test, block red checks, and hold irreversible or real-environment changes at land gates for a sign-off.
